No free entry

Listeners leave without a trace

Someone who has been quietly asking “stay or go?” for months can watch your content and never leave an email. You can’t follow up with people you never captured.

Products sit still

Your store only sells to people who find it

Let Them Go and You Already Know are already built. Without a class sending people to them, they depend on someone tapping your bio link on the right day.

No ads

Every application depends on today’s post

All of your demand is organic. A quiet week on Instagram means a quiet week of applications, and there’s no way to turn spend into booked calls.

Anyone not ready to apply today leaves with nothing, and you have no way to reach them again.

Who this is for

For anyone living between two answers

  • The question has been there for months, maybe years, and it gets louder when the house is quiet.
  • Lists of pros and cons have been written, and nothing has been decided.
  • Advice from friends and family pulls in opposite directions.
  • There is a sense of a different life underneath this one, and no clear way to look at it honestly.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why the question keeps coming back

What sits underneath “stay or go”, and why more information rarely settles it.

Desire: what you actually want

How to separate what you want from what you think you should want.

Shadow: the parts that decide for you

The fears and old stories that quietly keep the decision on hold.

How to tell fear from knowing

A simple way to notice the difference between a passing feeling and a clear signal.

Script 1 · “The question that won’t leave”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s why the stay-or-go question can follow someone around for years.”

Body

“It’s rarely because they don’t have enough information. Most people have already made the lists and asked everyone they trust. What keeps it open is what sits underneath: what they want, and what they’re afraid it will cost.”

CTA

“I’m teaching how to look at that honestly in a free 60-minute masterclass. The replay is included. Tap Sign up to save a seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, warm black-and-white grade to match your feed. Caption on screen: “stay or go?”

Script 2 · “Fear or knowing”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“How do you tell the difference between fear and knowing?”

Body

“Fear is loud and urgent. Knowing is usually quiet, and it keeps coming back. In my work, the people who find clarity are the ones who learn to hear the quiet one, without letting the loud one decide for them.”

CTA

“I walk through it in The Life Underneath, a free live class. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera. On-screen text “fear” then “knowing”, the second in wine colour.

Script 3 · “I won’t tell you what to do”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“I will never tell anyone whether to stay or leave.”

Body

“That decision belongs to them. What I do is help people look at desire, at shadow, and at the life underneath the one they’re living, until the answer is clear enough to trust.”

CTA

“If that sounds like the conversation you’ve been looking for, join my free masterclass. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to three title cards: Desire. Shadow. The life underneath.
